commentary.text: National Weather Service High Surf Advisory: watch the surf, stay off wet rock near the water, and keep kids close. With a High Surf Advisory in effect and waves exceeding eight feet, Dike Rock Tidepools are closed today. The daylight low of three feet offers limited exposure, especially since water is running higher than predicted. Visitors should pick another day for a proper tidepool experience. For water quality details, check local reports (source1).
